sources.document_title: TLV900x Low-Power, RRIO, 1-MHz Operational Amplifier for Cost-Sensitive Systems datasheet (TLV9001, TLV9002, TLV9004)
sources.locator: SBOS833R physical PDF page 14 of 110 (index 13), printed page 14: Section 7.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings table rows supply voltage, signal input pins voltage and current, footnote (2); Section 7.3 Recommended Operating Conditions table row VS
sources.evidence_extract: 7.1 Abs max: supply (V+)-(V-) 7 V; signal input common-mode (V-)-0.5 to (V+)+0.5 V; differential (V+)-(V-)+0.2 V; input current -10 to 10 mA. Footnote (2): input pins are diode-clamped to the supply rails; inputs that may swing more than 0.5 V beyond the rails must be current limited to 10 mA or less. 7.3 ROC: VS 1.8 to 5.5 V; TA -40 to 125 degC. Hash comparison: A5 recorded sha256 01a8a8c85d59bf49e80986f30c70b550b5056138737edabbf9775c86db868fbb (2026-11-05/06 (engineering/a5/electronics/source_provenance.json), id TI_TLV9001) for https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tlv9001.pdf; bytes inspected now (2026-11-08, HTTP 200, Content-Type application/pdf, starts %PDF-): 01a8a8c85d59bf49e80986f30c70b550b5056138737edabbf9775c86db868fbb - identical. 7.1 Abs max Temperature rows: operating TA -55 to 150 degC; junction TJ 150 degC max; storage Tstg -65 to 150 degC. 7.3 row TA 'Specified temperature' -40 to 125 degC. Row added 2026-11-11 from bytes re-downloaded by the cloud VM (HTTP 200, application/pdf) whose SHA-256 is identical to this record's; text layer read with pdftotext -layout on that page.
